description:
Create src/lib.rs to expose pub mod client and pub mod types, and move non-CLI core logic out of src/main.rs (including NOUL_YES_THRESHOLD, validate_request, parse_json_payload, score_decision_label, build_decision_value, and print_decision_summary) along with their unit tests. Update src/main.rs to import these symbols from jeb.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. src/lib.rs compiles and exports client, types, validate_request, parse_json_payload, score_decision_label, build_decision_value, and print_decision_summary.
2. Unit tests for payload parsing, request validation, and score/decision summary formatting move to src/lib.rs and pass.
3. src/main.rs imports shared logic from the jeb library crate without duplicate module declarations (mod client / mod types).
4. cargo test and cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings pass.
